text: My stepdaughter is 3 and she's staying with us this weekend, her mum's away and I'm panicking a bit because I've never had her poorly on my own before. She was sick once about 9 o'clock. Since then she's had a few drinks of water and some juice and kept it all down. She's got a little cough as well, not a bad one. She's wide awake now, sat on the sofa chatting to me about her cartoon like nothing happened. I just don't want to do the wrong thing and have her dad come home to find I messed up
